verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de's own docs say users register a webhook URL in the dashboard under /webhooks and receive real-time notifications of notarization events. Named events such as appointment.completed are documented, and payloads are HMAC-SHA256 signed for verification, so the core subscribe-to-events-via-webhooks story is covered first-party. missing for 10: a programmatic (API-based) way to register subscriptions, a complete event catalog with retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Register your webhook URL with Beglaubigt (via your dashboard under `/webhooks`).
Real-time updates: Get instant notifications when notarization events are completed.
This signature is generated using the HMAC-SHA256 algorithm and a secret key that is shared exclusively between Beglaubigt and your system.
The `appointment.completed` event is automatically triggered when the notary appointment date has passed.
